title: Agent activity ingest v1: one activity record
description: The complete work activity summary of one group: one thread of one agent session on one UTC day and issue segment. Sending a record again replaces what is stored for its idempotency key. Which properties a record may hold depends on its level: a property above the level rejects the record.

idempotency_key.description: Names the group for its target user. Printable ASCII without spaces. Recommended: the lower-case hex SHA-256 of 'v1|activity|<tool>|<session_id>|<thread or ->|<usage_date>|<issue or ->'.

usage_key.description: The idempotency_key of a usage record (specivo.ai-usage.v1) of the same tool, session and usage_date, already sent by the same account for the same target user. The activity takes its issue, project and visibility from that entry.

tool.description: Slug of the AI tool; must be the tool of the usage entry usage_key names.

session_id.description: Opaque id of the tool's session; must be the session of the usage entry usage_key names.

usage_date.description: The UTC day of the group (YYYY-MM-DD); must be the day of the usage entry usage_key names.

level.description: The privacy level the record was built at. A property of a higher level rejects the record.

activity_version.description: Version of the summary definition the reporter used; 1 for this contract. Stored, never interpreted.

thread.description: Level counts. Opaque id of the thread: a hash in hex or base64url (1 to 64 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '_' and '-'), never a name or path; null for the session's only thread.

categories.description: Level counts. Tool runs and their summed seconds by category. A key outside the fixed list rejects the record.

files_changed.description: Level counts. Number of distinct files edited.

lines_added.description: Level counts. Lines added, from the patches.

lines_removed.description: Level counts. Lines removed, from the patches.

subagents_spawned.description: Level counts. Number of child threads started.

test_runs.description: Level counts. Commands classified as test runs, and how many of them ended with an error (failed <= count).

timeline.description: Level counts. The thread's active spans labelled with their main category: sorted, not overlapping, each ending after it starts, within 24 hours of usage_date.

mcp_servers.description: Level names. Runs and seconds per MCP server name; each server once.

commands.description: Level names. Runs and failures per command name: a program's base name, for git also its verb ('git commit'). Never arguments. Each name once; failed <= count.

files.description: Level names. Edited files by repository-relative path: no leading '/', '\\' or '~', no drive letter, no '..' segment, no ':' (so no drive letters or URLs), no backslash, control or bidirectional formatting characters. Each path once.

files_outside.description: Level names. Edited files counted but not named: outside the repository, or withheld by the reporter's patterns.

agent_type.description: Level names. The subagent's type name: 1 to 100 characters of letters, digits, space, '_', '.', ':', '@', '+' and '-', starting with a letter or digit (no '/').

commits.description: Level commits. Commits made in the group's time: SHA, branch, subject line (at most 200 characters) and commit time. Each SHA once.

on_behalf_of.description: Any level. Login of the person the activity belongs to, when it is not the account that sends the batch; as in specivo.ai-usage.v1.

segment.description: [start, end, category]: two RFC 3339 timestamps with an offset and the category that took most of the span.
